🚀 Mailu | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Self-hosting a private, feature-rich, and secure email server using Docker.
✨ Key Features: • Standard email server (IMAP, SMTP) • Advanced email features (aliases, routing, search) • Web access (Webmail, admin interface) • User features (auto-reply, fetched accounts) • Admin features (delegation, quotas)
📖 Summary: Mailu is a comprehensive, free, and open-source email server solution distributed as Docker images. It provides standard and advanced email functionalities, web access, and robust security features, making it easy to set up and maintain a private email server.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 browsr | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Navigating and managing files across diverse local and remote storage systems directly from the terminal.
✨ Key Features: • Terminal-based file explorer (TUI) • Supports local and remote filesystems • Integrates with GitHub, SSH, AWS S3, Google Cloud Storage, Azure Blob Storage • Syntax highlighting for code files • JSON file formatting
📖 Summary: Browsr is a Python-based terminal file explorer that allows users to navigate and interact with local and remote filesystems. It supports various cloud storage services and offers features like syntax highlighting, JSON formatting, and data table rendering.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 AirGuard | Kotlin
🎯 Primary Use Case: Protecting Android users from being covertly tracked by Apple AirTags and similar devices.
✨ Key Features: • Detects AirTags and other Find My devices • Notifies users of potential tracking • Allows users to play a sound on detected AirTags • Displays historical tracking locations • Voluntary participation in a research study
📖 Summary: AirGuard is an Android application designed to protect users from unwanted tracking by Apple AirTags and other Find My compatible devices. It scans the surroundings for these trackers and notifies the user if a device is following them, allowing them to locate and disable it.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 arozos | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a functional and user-friendly desktop operating system experience on low-power devices, enabling them to act as personal cloud storage, home servers, or network-attached storage solutions.
✨ Key Features: • Web Desktop Interface • File Manager with drag-and-drop, upload • Realtime Network Statistics • Static Web Server with built-in editor • Mount Local and Remote File Systems (WebDAV, SMB, SFTP)
📖 Summary: ArozOS is a web-based desktop operating system designed for low-power platforms like Raspberry Pi. It provides a user-friendly interface with features for file management, networking, and security, aiming to create a personal cloud or home server experience.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🌟 botasaurus | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Building undetectable web scrapers that can bypass advanced bot detection mechanisms.
✨ Key Features: • Bypass Cloudflare, BrowserScan, Fingerprint, Datadome bot detection • Bypass Cloudflare Turnstile CAPTCHA • Perform realistic, human-like mouse movements • Convert scrapers into desktop apps (Mac, Windows, Linux) • Turn scrapers into websites
📖 Summary: Botasaurus is a Python web scraping framework designed to build robust and undetectable scrapers. It simplifies complex tasks like bypassing bot detection systems and CAPTCHAs, offering features for human-like interaction, parallel processing, and cost reduction.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

💡 clip-finder | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Enabling users to quickly find specific information within YouTube videos by searching their transcripts semantically and jumping directly to the relevant timestamp.
✨ Key Features: • Semantic transcript search with timestamped YouTube links • Channel, playlist, and single-video indexing • Smart skip for already-indexed videos • Local BYOK support via browser storage
📖 Summary: SearchTube is an AI-powered tool for semantic search of YouTube video transcripts. It allows users to index entire channels, playlists, or individual videos and then search through their content using natural language queries. The results provide exact timestamp links to the relevant moments in the videos.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source
